title: AEM policy violations: the Policy Violations page, views, charts, columns and drawer

prose.label: Actions and drawer.
prose.text: {{bulk-actions}} {{drawer}} The drawer tab contents are open {{gap:drawer-tabs}}. Policies that generate violations are in [[aem.policies]]; violations are aggregated into tickets in [[aem.violation-tickets]].

definition.statement: Each AEM policy violation represents a deviation from established security policies detected on an asset, aggregated with context such as severity, violation origins and affected asset types.

quotes: Each policy violation represents a deviation from established security policies detected on an asset and aggregated with additional contextual information such as severity, violation origins, and affected asset types.

system-views.statement: The Policy Violations page's system-saved views with predefined filter selections include Active Violations, Active Critical and High Violations, CMDB Hygiene Policy Violations (generated by the CMDB Hygiene policy) and Coverage Policy Violations (generated by the Tool Coverage policy).

quotes: System-saved views with predefined filter selections include:
Active Violations: All active policy violations.
Active Critical and High Violations: Active policy violations with critical or high severity.
CMDB Hygiene Policy Violations: Policy violations generated by the CMDB Hygiene policy.
Coverage Policy Violations: Policy violations generated by the Tool Coverage policy.

filters-group.statement: Policy violations can be filtered by Severity, Policy Name, State or Asset Type, and grouped by fields such as Severity, Asset Type, Policy Name or Assignee.

quotes: Filter policy violations by Severity, Policy Name, State, or Asset Type.
Group policy violations by fields such as Severity, Asset Type, Policy Name, or Assignee.

charts.statement: The Policy Violations Overview charts show violations by severity, by policy name and by asset type, and adjust to the selected view and filters.

quotes: The charts are adjusted based on the selected view and filters:
Policy violations by severity: Displays a breakdown of violations grouped by their severity level.
Policy violations by policy name: Displays a breakdown of violations grouped by the policy they were generated from.
Policy violations by asset type: Highlights the affected asset types, such as Applications or Windows Workloads.

bulk-actions.statement: Bulk actions on selected policy violations are Update (for example resolution SLA or assignment) and Create 3rd party Issue, and the list can be exported as a CSV file.

quotes: Update: Update the details of a group of selected violations (e.g., resolution SLA, assignment).
Create 3rd party Issue: Dispatch selected violations to external work management systems (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow).
Export the list of policy violations and their associated details as a CSV file for offline analysis or reporting.

columns.statement: With the default Active Violations view, a policy violation shows a Severity Score assigned in the configured policy, First Seen (the date the violation was generated) and Last Seen (the most recent date it was still detected).

quotes: When the default Active Violations saved view is selected, you can see the following details for each policy violation:
Severity Score: The severity score assigned to the policy violation in the configured policy.
First Seen: The date the policy violation was generated.
Last Seen: The most recent date that the policy violation was still detected.

drawer.statement: The actions available in the policy violation drawer depend on the user role in the AEM app, and the drawer shows detailed information including the affected asset, policy name and severity score.

quotes: The actions you can perform in the violation drawer depend on your user role in the AEM app.
Clicking a policy violation on the Policy Violations page opens the violation's drawer, where you can view detailed information including the affected asset, policy name, and severity score.

drawer-tabs.title: What the policy violation drawer tabs contain
drawer-tabs.detail: The drawer page lists Top Panel, Details and Asset Info but shows only an image placeholder; the fields in each section are not captured.
